# UIItemStackComponent

*Client* · extends [`UIComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIComponent)

Item slot of a script UI: shows an item stack and lets the player choose another one; the callback gets the chosen stack.

## Methods

### stack {#stack}

::: member

Shows a stack in the slot without calling the callback.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stack` | `ItemStack` | Minecraft item stack, e.g. `scram.item("minecraft:apple").getMinecraftItemStack()` |

**Returns** [`UIItemStackComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIItemStackComponent) — this item slot

:::
